messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — completed and executed
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Patent and Technology Licence Agreement has been signed by both parties and is now effective as of today, 11 December 2025. The fully executed agreement is attached. Halverson will issue the invoice for the £4.5m upfront fee, payable within 30 days under clause 6.1.

Thank you all for a constructive negotiation. We'll circulate a completion bible shortly.

Kind regards,
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
+44 (0)20 7946 1200
